projectTitle: Courier React Native SDK (courier.com): Notification Inbox, Push and Preferences
description: Official React Native SDK for Courier (courier.com), the notification platform. Add a prebuilt in-app notification Inbox (CourierInboxView), APNs and FCM push notifications with token sync and delivery tracking, and a notification preference center to React Native and Expo apps.
rules: Use @trycourier/courier-react-native. Do not use the web packages (@trycourier/courier-react) or the deprecated v7 @trycourier/react-inbox in React Native.
Sign in with await Courier.shared.signIn({ accessToken: jwt, userId }).
Use CourierInboxView for the prebuilt Inbox and CourierPreferencesView for preferences; use Courier.shared.addInboxListener for a custom UI and remove it on unmount.
After npm install, run cd ios && pod install, then complete the native iOS and Android push setup in docs/push-notifications.md.
Mint the Courier JWT on your backend with your Courier API key (POST /auth/issue-token). Never put the API key in the app.
Call signIn once, after your own login resolves. Credentials persist across app launches. Call signOut when the user logs out.
The user_id in the JWT scope must match the userId passed to signIn, or the Inbox loads empty.
Scopes: inbox:read:messages inbox:write:events for Inbox; add read:preferences write:preferences for preferences and write:user-tokens for push.
Always set expires_in when minting. The SDK does not refresh tokens: mint a new JWT and call signIn again before it expires.
EU workspaces: mint the JWT at https://api.eu.courier.com/auth/issue-token and pass EU apiUrls to signIn. Token and client must be in the same region.
